title.en: Electric 60 Concrete Pump — Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path — read beside “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator”
title.zh: 相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80——只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。——对照「U-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」来读

description.en: Electric 60 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path Only Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m
description.zh: 相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80见 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m。

h1.en: Z-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator is the heading; Electric 60 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「Z-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」，主体仍是相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 60 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path. Only Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m. A measured line near 900 m is not an Electric 60 cell. HBT80-16 prints 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm, not 1800 mm of width. Electric 80 is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, 900 m / 300 m and 6000 kg. Electric 60 is 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³ and 3300 kg, with three stone rows. A buyer who measures a frame of 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm still has two electric pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The section title “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m。按路径使用 3300 kg 或 6000 kg。接近 900 m 的实测管路不是电动60的格子。HBT80-16 印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm，宽度不是 1800 mm。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、3300 kg，并有三行石子。量到外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm 的买家，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然面对两张电动页。电动80是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、900 m / 300 m、6000 kg。节标题「U-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.zh: U-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器

body.en: “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” titles this part of the Electric 60 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path. A measured line near 900 m is not an Electric 60 cell. Electric 60 is 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³ and 3300 kg, with three stone rows.
body.zh: 「U-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」是相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。按路径使用 3300 kg 或 6000 kg。接近 900 m 的实测管路不是电动60的格子。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、3300 kg，并有三行石子。

heading.zh: Z-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器

body.en: For Electric 60 Concrete Pump, the heading “Z-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” does not replace a cell. Only Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m. HBT80-16 prints 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm, not 1800 mm of width. A buyer who measures a frame of 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm still has two electric pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai.
body.zh: 对相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80而言，标题「Z-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」并不替换任何格子。只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。HBT80-16 印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm，宽度不是 1800 mm。量到外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm 的买家，在河北品锦机械（邢台）仍然面对两张电动页。

heading.zh: L-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器

body.en: Electric 60 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “L-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator”. Electric 60’s fine-stone pair is 200 m / 600 m. Electric 80 is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, 900 m / 300 m and 6000 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-expansion-loop-d_1069.html.
body.zh: 相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80不因标题「L-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」而改动。电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m。电动80是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、900 m / 300 m、6000 kg。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-expansion-loop-d_1069.html。

question.en: Does “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” replace Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path?
question.zh: 「U-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」会替换「只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。」吗？

answer.en: No. Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path remains the printed wording for Electric 60 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。仍是相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Only Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m belong on the Electric 60 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80这一行里，「电动60的细石是 200 m / 600 m。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Z-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” add to Electric 60 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「Z-弯头 膨胀 补偿器 计算器」给相同的 6600 mm 外形订不出电动80增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-expansion-loop-d_1069.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-expansion-loop-d_1069.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Use 3300 kg or 6000 kg with the path?
question.zh: 「只有电动80印 900 m / 300 m。」旁边印了标价吗？
